txt_scheme_creator_contract.meaning: empty value means not encrypted / not creator locked in the user-verified main-scheme software display
txt_scheme_creator_contract.delivery_gate: If encryption/lock is not explicitly requested, every delivered MAIN SCHEME TXT must contain SchemeCreator= with an empty value. Do not apply this rule mechanically to advanced betting export files.

advanced_betting_export_contract.scheme_creator_policy: software-exported advanced betting files may contain a non-empty SchemeCreator value; preserve an existing exported value during round-trip edits and do not infer main-scheme encryption semantics from it

integer_multiplier_contract.scope: ordinary/straight betting plans in delivered TXT and advanced betting 倍数 fields
integer_multiplier_contract.applies_when: 倍投类型=0 or ordinary straight-line multiplier fields are present, or advanced betting config contains 倍数=
integer_multiplier_contract.allowed_pattern: positive integers separated by commas only for ordinary plans; single positive integer for each advanced state 倍数
integer_multiplier_contract.delivery_gate: All betting multipliers are positive integers. Any decimal point in a multiplier fails the package.

fixed_pick_content_contract.scope: delivered 固定取码 MAIN SCHEME TXT files
fixed_pick_content_contract.grammar: 位置范围|开出号码段|投注内容
fixed_pick_content_contract.problem_to_prevent: Do not mechanically write every open-number segment as 0-0; it creates a fake no-design package.
fixed_pick_content_contract.recommended_design: Use explainable low/mid/high open-number segment roles such as 0-2, 3-5, 6-9, 0-3, 4-8, 7-9. Each segment must have a role in the evidence record.

public_ppt_contract.audience: ordinary lottery players watching a video
public_ppt_contract.purpose: teach an artificial betting thought process, not explain how the private automation package was generated
required_story_questions: 倍投只是资金管理不是提高命中
连续不中如何停止或减压
